API: Authentication Service API
Version: 1.0.0
Description: REST API for user authentication, session management, and token issuance.
Base path: /auth
Host:

Endpoint: /auth/login
  Method: POST
  Summary: Authenticate a user
  Description: Authenticates a user with email and password. Returns an access token and refresh token pair on success. Enforces a rate limit of 8 requests per minute per client IP.
  Tags: Authentication
  Parameters:
    - email (body, string, required=True)
    - password (body, string, required=True)
  Responses:
    - 200: Authentication successful; returns AuthResponse
    - 401: Invalid email or password
    - 423: Account locked due to repeated failed attempts
    - 429: Rate limit exceeded: maximum 8 login requests per minute per client IP

Endpoint: /auth/mfa
  Method: POST
  Summary: Submit MFA verification code
  Description: Completes authentication for accounts with multi-factor authentication enabled by submitting a time-based one-time password (TOTP) code.
  Tags: Authentication
  Parameters:
    - mfaCode (body, string, required=True)
  Responses:
    - 200: MFA verified; returns AuthResponse
    - 401: Invalid or expired MFA code

Endpoint: /auth/refresh
  Method: POST
  Summary: Refresh an access token
  Description: Issues a new access token using a valid, non-expired refresh token.
  Tags: Token Management
  Responses:
    - 200: New access token issued
    - 401: Refresh token invalid or expired

Endpoint: /auth/logout
  Method: POST
  Summary: Terminate the current session
  Description: Invalidates the caller's active session and associated tokens.
  Tags: Session Management
  Responses:
    - 200: Session terminated

Schema: AuthResponse
Description: Returned on successful authentication or token refresh.
  - accessToken (string): Short-lived JWT signed with RS256
  - refreshToken (string): Long-lived opaque token
  - expiresIn (integer): Access token lifetime in seconds
  - tokenType (string): Always 'Bearer'
